incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: hosted-inference-high-5xx (service: hosted-01)
incident-bot: Severity: P1. Customers experiencing elevated 5xx and increased latency.
pagerduty-bot: Escalation: primary on-call leo did not ack within 2m -> secondary maya notified.
leo: just woke up to the page, looking now. can someone paste the first error traces?
maya: seeing duplicate alerts flooding PD, looks like same upstream error repeated during a 30s burst.
maya: paging chain escalated to manager after secondary ack timeout (PD policy).
leo: quick status: logs show rapid rate of `internal_service::respond 503` with kv-cache misses.
leo: running `curl -sS https://hosted-01.prod.redwood/api/health | jq '.'`
leo: output: "{ "status":"degraded", "5xx_rate": 0.18 }"
sam: I'm on infra, checking autoscaler and GPU pool.
sam: `kubectl --context prod get pods -l app=hosted-inference -o wide` shows many pods Ready but OOM kill spikes on node gpu-3.
ops-bot: Automated suppressor engaged: duplicate-alert-suppression applied for 60s to reduce noise.
maya: receiving PD for secondary -> i tried to ack but PD timed out? ack button not responsive in mobile.
maya: paging logs show secondary ACK attempt failed due to PD mobile oauth error.
pagerduty-bot: Escalation: manager jordan-manager notified (escalation policy: after 3 failed acks).
jordan-manager: awake, joining bridge. remote VPN due to travel but i'm on. starting triage.
jordan-manager: @leo @sam, recommended immediate mitigation: 1) set temporary rate-limit on public ingress 2) shift a subset of traffic to fallback-region.
leo: pushing traffic-split: set `X-Region-Override: us-west-2` for 10% of traffic to fallback pool.
leo: applying ingress throttle rule: `rate-limit per-ip 20r/s`
sam: scaling up spare dedicated pool in us-west-2, spinning 2 nodes.
sam: `gcloud compute instances start --ids gpu-fallback-1,gpu-fallback-2` (logs: starting)
ops-bot: suppression reminder: we've suppressed duplicate PD pages; manual acknowlegment required for remaining active incidents.
maya: acked on web console at 12:04. verified mobile oauth flakiness.
leo: we see 5xx rate drop to 0.05 after throttle and failover shift, getting telemetry in 30s.
jordan-manager: great. customer impact: confirmed partial degradation for small subset of customers (approx 2.3% of requests), prioritized support ticket batch created.
jordan-manager: action items: 1) investigate PD mobile oauth timeouts 2) postmortem if root cause is autoscaler/GPU node flapping 3) refine duplicate-alert suppression rules.
leo: noting timeframe: started 12:02, mitigated 12:06, total noisy pages ~12.
maya: leaving follow-up to runbook owner to add mobile PD token retry and increase suppressor frequency for bursty errors.
sam: will follow up with infra-runbook to add graceful node-shedding config.
jordan-manager: closing immediate incident in PD once we confirm 30m stable. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident update posted to ops-incident-log.
leo: putting short incident note in #postmortems when we have timeline and logs.
